notes.title: Operating frequency
notes.body:
Data is 5 bytes (10-byte BCD), little-endian. Digit order: byte-1 low = 10 Hz, byte-1 high = 1 Hz, byte-2 low = 1 kHz, byte-2 high = 100 Hz, byte-3 low = 100 kHz, byte-3 high = 10 kHz, byte-4 low = 10 MHz, byte-4 high = 1 MHz, byte-5 low = 1 GHz (0 fixed), byte-5 high = 100 MHz (0-3 on IC-7610). MAIN/SUB band selection: see command 07.

Commands 00 / 03 / 05 read or set transceive frequency; command 1C 03 reads the transmit frequency in Split.

notes.title: Operating mode
notes.body:
Data is 1-2 bytes.
Byte 1 - operating mode: 00=LSB, 01=USB, 02=AM, 03=CW, 04=RTTY, 05=FM, 07=CW-R, 08=RTTY-R.
Byte 2 - filter: 01=FIL1, 02=FIL2, 03=FIL3 (optional with commands 01 and 06; FIL1/default selected when omitted).

With command 06, mode changes in transceive are output.

notes.title: Scope waveform data
notes.body:
Outputs the waveform data to the controller
1 Main or Sub scope data
• 00=Main scope, 01=Sub scope
2 Order of division data (Current)
3 Division number (01 or 15)
When data is sent to the controller through the
LAN port, all data is sent together. However,
when the data is sent through the USB port, the
data is divided by 15 and sent in sequential order.
Division number Data length
LAN 01 704
USB 15
1st data 15
later data 53
15th data 42
The 1st data sends only the wave information
(1 ~ 6) without the waveform data (7).
The 2nd or later data sends the minimum wave
information (1 ~ 3) with waveform data (7).
4 Spectrum scope mode data:
• 00 = Center mode scope
• 01 = Fixed mode scope
• 02 = SCROLL-C mode scope
• 03 = SCROLL-F mode scope
5 Waveform information:
The waveform information differs, depending on
the Spectrum scope mode.
• In the Center mode:
Center frequency and span are sent.
See page 10 for Operating frequency data, and the
Scope span settings to the right.
• In the Fixed, SCROLL-C, and SCROLL-F modes:
Lower edge and higher edge frequencies are sent.
